title.narrative: Knowledge Centre for Seed Value Enhancement in India

description.narrative: The Knowledge Centre for Seed Value Enhancement (KCSVE) is an Indo-Dutch collaborative platform designed to bridge critical gaps in India's seed value enhancement sector. The project aims to systematically adapt, validate, and scale advanced seed-enhancement technologies, whilst addressing both supply- and demand side constraints.KCSVE enables seed enterprises, small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), service providers, farmers, and farmer producer organisations (FPOs) to adopt advanced technologies and improve product quality and competitiveness. The project achieves this through targeted capacity-building, demonstration and validation activities across agro-climatic zones, development of standardised protocols and quality systems, and policy engagement to strengthen certification processes and market access.KCSVE will result in increased adoption of value-enhanced seeds, improved farmer productivity and resilience, and enhanced competitiveness of the seed sector. By strengthening technical capabilities, improving access to validated technologies, and reinforcing ecosystem linkages, the project enables sustainable business models and supports the emergence of a service ecosystem around seed enhancement. This generates structural employment opportunities and drives sustainable sectoral growth within India's seed industry.The consortium brings together global technology leadership from Incotec (Croda), Fowler Westrup brings in seed treatment equipment through its Dutch subsidiary Seed Processing Holland, biological innovation from Telluris Biotech, and seed production and market linkages from Sagi Seeds, with the University of Agricultural Sciences (UAS) Dharwad serving as a key implementation and training partner within the platform. Sathguru Management Consultants will serve as the national coordinator, driving implementation, private sector engagement, studies, and policy dialogue.
